question: Which scriptures should be studied during the second part of the day?
premises: The second part of the day is specified.
The Vedas and the divine Āgamas are named as objects of study.
inference: In the second part of the day one should study the Vedas and also the divine Āgamas.
plain_english: But in the second part of the day, one should study the Vedas and also the divine Āgamas.
